name: The Lathspell
body:
The Lathspell is a reimagining of the curse wielding battle mage class introduced in the guide for warriors from the 3.5 edition of the world’s most popular roleplaying game. The primary goal of this redesign is to increase the versatility of this class’s previously narrow features and expand the curse ability into a branching path which affects what abilities are gained. The original class had a single primary feature, a short spell list, and little opportunity to expand your abilities and or attempt more than a handful of possible builds.

Despite this, it was initially fun to play with excellent thematics, the goal is to maintain and enhance these aspects of the class while expanding available playstyles.

Lathspells are bringers of doom, intentional or not.

Carrying a curse within that longs to reach outward and spread to other beings, these dangerous mages inspire awe and fear alike in their enemies. Whether giving in to the corruption that haunts them or using it to nobler ends a Lathspell walks a potentially troubled road. Through physical and mental fortitude and a sharp spirit Lathspells can master and direct their inner power to bring death, destruction, or misfortune only when called upon. Weaving new curses, spreading their own, and using a domineering will, a Lathspell ensures their foes feel their arrival means only one thing; bad news.

Role: The lathspell is a frontline debilitator that works as a powerful counterpoint to the paladin’s more supportive-frontline playstyle.

Hit Die: d10

Starting Wealth: 5d6 x 10 (180 gp). In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Skills

The Lathspell’s class skills and the key ability for each skill are: Bluff (Cha), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Disguise (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (dungeoneering) (Int), Knowledge (local) (Int), Knowledge (planes) (Int), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Cha), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), Swim (Str), Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier

Class Features

The following are the class features of the lathspell.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

The lathspell is proficient with all simple and martial weapons as well as light armor and shields (but not tower shields).

Spellcasting

A lathspell casts arcane spells drawn primarily from the lathspell spell list, found below.

They can cast any spell they know without preparing it ahead of time. To learn or cast a spell, a lathspell must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a lathspell’s spell is 10 + the spell level + the lathspell’s Charisma modifier.

Like other spellcasters, a lathspell can cast only a certain number of spells per day as noted on Table: The Lathspell Spellcasting. In addition, they receive bonus spells per day if they have a high Charisma score.

A lathspell knows only a limited number of spells. They may cast any spell they have know at any time, provided they still have remaining spells available of the proper spell level as shown on Table: The Lathspell Spellcasting.

Unlike other spell casters, a lathspell may cast spells from the lathspell spell list in light armor or when wielding a shield (but not a tower shield), without incurring arcane spell failure.

Cantrips: Lathspells can prepare a number of cantrips, or 0-level spells, each day, as noted on Table: The Lathspell Spellcasting These spells are cast like any other spell, but they are not expended when cast and may be used again.

Lathspell’s Curse (Su)

Every lathspell draws power from a curse that has become entwined into their soul, as much a part of them as their own bodies. At 1st level choose from among the curses listed at: Lathspell Curses.

If an ability granted by a curse allows a saving throw, the DC is 10 + 1/2 the lathspell’s class level + the lathspell’s Charisma modifier, unless otherwise noted.

Curse Ability (Su or Ex)

Each lathspell’s curse grants abilities selected from a list presented in their curse descriptions. A lathspell gains a new curse ability at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th levels.

Stubborn Soul (Su)

At 2nd level, a life shared with a damning curse has strengthened the soul, granting a bonus on all saving throws made against spells and spell-like abilities equal to the lathspell’s Charisma modifier.

Cloak of Menace (Su)

At 3rd level, the curse housed in the lathspell’s soul affects the world around them at all times. All enemies within 10 feet of the lathspell take a -2 penalty on all saving throws as long as the lathspell is aware of them and conscious.

Bonus Feat (Ex)

At 4th level and again at 10th, 16th and 19th levels, the lathspell gains a bonus feat. These feats must be a combat feat or Combat Casting. The lathspell must still meet all the prerequisites for these feats.

Expanded Knowledge (Su)

At 5th level and every four levels thereafter, the lathspell gains additional spell knowledge. They may add two spells from the sorcerer/wizard spell list of the conjuration, evocation, or illusion schools to their spell list and to their spells known. These spells must be of a spell level no higher than the maximum level the lathspell can cast.

Armored Casting (Ex)

At 6th level and again at 11th level, the lathspell’s time casting spells while armored leads to an improvement in that ability. At 6th level they may now cast spells from the lathspell spell list in medium armor and gain medium armor proficiency and at 11th level they gain the same benefits for heavy armor, additionally their stalwart ability functions while the lathspell is wearing heavy armor.

Stalwart (Ex)

At 7th level, the lathspell can use mental and physical resilience to avoid certain attacks. If they make a Fortitude or Will saving throw against an attack that has a reduced effect on a successful save, they instead avoid the effect entirely. This ability can only be used if the lathspell is wearing armor for which they are proficient. A helpless lathspell does not gain the benefit of the stalwart ability.

Cursed Strike (Su)

At 8th level the lathspell’s mastery over curses grants them a potent ability in combat.

Whenever the lathspell threatens a critical hit with a weapon attack they may cast a spell with the curse descriptor or a spell of the necromancy school as a free action. Additionally if a spell with the curse descriptor requires the lathspell to touch the target they may deliver that curse with a weapon attack as part of casting the spell.

Penetrating Curse (Su)

At 12th level, the lathspell’s ability to curse their foes strengthens.

Whenever a spell with the curse or evil descriptors is cast by the lathspell and it allows for a saving throw, the save DC is increased by +2. This ability stacks with feats such as Spell Focus.

Improved Stalwart (Ex)

At 14th level the lathspell’s stalwart ability improves, even on a failed fortitude or will saving throw against an attack the lathspell still only takes the reduced effect, if applicable.

Greater Cloak of Menace (Su)

At 15th level, the lathspell’s cloak of menace expands and affects all enemies within 30 ft.

Walking Curse (Su)

At 20th level, the lathspell becomes one with the curse housed in their soul.

Their type changes to native outsider, they gain immunity to spells and effects with the curse descriptor, as well as additional powers determined by their curse.
